# Kanya Hunt — Couverture Cake Artist

> Kanya Hunt is a Cape Town-based couverture cake artist and qualified dietician with 25 years of chocolate work. She designs and hand-crafts bespoke chocolate wedding cakes, celebration cakes, and artisan weekend cakes for clients in Cape Town and the Western Cape Winelands.

## Key facts

- **Location**: 4 Starfish Way, Atlantic Beach Estate, Melkbosstrand, Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
- **Service area**: Cape Town, Atlantic Seaboard, Southern Suburbs, Cape Winelands, broader Western Cape on request
- **Contact**: kanya@kanyahunt.co.za | WhatsApp +27 82 375 5200
- **Instagram**: @kanyahunt
- **Facebook**: facebook.com/kanya.hunt.wedding.cakes
- **Specialism**: Couverture chocolate (primarily Callebaut Belgian chocolate). Every decorative element is hand-sculpted — petals, ruffles, spirals, botanical textures, wafer paper, fresh and dried florals
- **Credentials**: Qualified dietician; Galliova Award 2003
- **Design philosophy**: Cakes designed to be served as the wedding dessert. No fondant. No copying other designers' work. Every commission is an original.
- **Pricing**: Wedding cakes from R3,500. Weekend Cakes from R975.

## Pages

### Homepage (/)
Overview of all offerings. Wedding Cakes (Couverture Chocolate, White Couverture, Buttercream & Sugar Art) and Special Occasions (Celebration Cakes, Petite Creations). Includes enquiry form.

### Couverture Chocolate Wedding Cakes (/chocolate-weddings.html)
Portfolio of dark couverture chocolate wedding cakes. Signature work: hand-sculpted chocolate petals, ruffles, spirals, and botanical elements. Two-tier from R3,500; three-tier from R5,250; four-tier from R6,500+.

### White Couverture Wedding Cakes (/white-chocolate-weddings.html)
Portfolio of white couverture chocolate wedding cakes. Pearl-on-pearl finishes, blush ruffles, ivory florals. Same pricing structure as dark chocolate.

### Celebration Cakes (/celebration-cakes.html)
Bespoke cakes for birthdays, anniversaries, milestones, and celebrations. Made to order.

### Petite Creations (/croquembouche-minis.html)
Individual mini cakes and cupcakes — each one a complete experience in a single serving.

### Buttercream & Sugar Art (/buttercream-sugar-art.html)
Buttercream and sugar art commissions. Available by request alongside the chocolate signature.

### Weekend Cakes (/weekend-cakes.html)
A weekly rotating artisan cake menu. Menu announced Monday. Orders close midday Wednesday. Friday collection or delivery from Melkbosstrand. R975–R1,065 per cake, 16 portions. Join the WhatsApp list for weekly menus.

### Real Weddings Gallery (/gallery.html)
Portfolio of couverture chocolate cakes in real Cape Town and Winelands wedding venues.

### About Kanya (/about.html)
Kanya Hunt's story: 25 years of couverture chocolate work. Qualified dietician. Galliova Award 2003. Studio at 4 Starfish Way, Atlantic Beach Estate, Melkbosstrand. Tasting sessions Mondays 10am–5pm by prior arrangement.

### FAQ (/faq.html)
Answers on: booking, tasting sessions, flavour list, pricing, delivery, freshness, and how to commission a cake.

## Pricing

| Product | From | Notes |
|---------|------|-------|
| 2-tier wedding cake | R3,500 | ~40 guests |
| 3-tier wedding cake | R5,250 | ~60–80 guests |
| 4-tier wedding cake | R6,500+ | ~100–140 guests |
| Single tall-tier commission | R2,750 | Design by Kanya |
| Weekend Cake | R975–R1,065 | 16 portions, weekly menu |
| Tasting session (standalone) | R550 | Refunded against R1,000 deposit |
| Booking deposit | R1,000 | Secures date + covers tasting |

## What Kanya does NOT do

- Fondant work
- Copy or recreate other artists' designs
- Compromise on ingredient quality

## Booking process

1. Enquiry via website form or WhatsApp (+27 82 375 5200)
2. Kanya responds personally within 48 hours
3. Tasting at the studio (Mondays 10am–5pm, by arrangement)
4. R1,000 deposit secures the date and covers the tasting

## Wedding cake flavours

Dark Belgian ganache (salted caramel or white chocolate ganache variations), classic chocolate with chocolate buttercream and caramel, Belgian chocolate mousse, hazelnut chocolate crema, black forest (top tier only), tiramisu (top tier only), Italian torta (top tier only), carrot and pecan, hummingbird, red velvet, lemon posset, berry posset, classic vanilla bean and caramel, Gran's orange buttercream, granadilla buttercream. Fruit cake on rare request.

## Ingredients

Butter, free-range farm eggs (sourced locally in Melkbosstrand), fresh cream and long-life cream imported from France, Callebaut Belgian couverture chocolate and cocoa powder, fresh milk, fresh seasonal fruit and premium frozen berries, homemade curds, organic lemons, house buttercream developed over years of refinement. Every recipe is mixed as a single batch.
